inventoryRationale.TorusNature_TreeA: Broad canopy trees only on garden/broad terrace floors; clustered shade and layered views supplement 56 conserved fruit trees.
inventoryRationale.TorusNature_ShrubA: Low irregular understory islands soften slab edges without blocking civic windows or public crossings.
inventoryRationale.TorusNature_FlowersA: Warm flower ribbons trace asymmetric arcs and small corner gardens; no central lawn fill or uniformly spaced tree avenues.
inventoryRationale.TorusBench_A: Inward-facing conversation corners, reading places and water-edge seats; existing integrated benches remain unchanged.
inventoryRationale.TorusTable_A: Small public gathering rooms, paired with nearby seating rather than furnishing every narrow circulation shelf.
inventoryRationale.TorusPlanter_A: Small planted terrace-edge boxes soften architecture while maintaining conserved facade and circulation aprons.
inventoryRationale.TorusNature_PondA: Distinct quiet static water rooms between retained crosswalks; full pond geometry sits on existing park floors.

sourceFacts: SP-413 figs. 5-5 and 5-7 depict planted pedestrian terraces, grouped homes and framed views.
Existing parcel allocations, curved floors, built-in stairs, source IDs and fruit trees are conserved.
interpretation: Existing native-kit models at their intended scale; water gardens are static visual amenities, not swimming/fluid systems.
Layered shrub/flower accents and clustered shade trees replace no existing objects; narrow terraces and center lawns remain empty.
Furniture on verified landscape floors only, not guessed roofs. Public routes are reservation metadata on existing support, not new rendered paving.
Tree crowns, facade aprons, existing decoration, deck headroom and the complete tube envelope are conservatively reserved.
integrationNotes: Parent owns physical basin/terrace connections and full-scene renderer/gameplay verification.
Preserve 4 m central and 2.1 m side garden promenades plus all original crosswalks; join terrace connectionPoints without intruding into gardens.
No objects reach the planned height-0 overhead ring promenade.

summaries.source: SP-413 Figs 5-4/5-7 and sp413-s02268; detailed plan is authored interpretation
summaries.capacityNote: Explicit single homes and three-home rows only. Apartment shells and district blocks do not establish independent dwellings or occupants; no 10,000-person completion claim.
summaries.preservation: No baseline replacements. New footprints avoid z[-7,7] and existing 24m spoke landings. Original Garden Court/service/exterior records retained; preexisting B promenade clutter requires the authored north bypass.
limitations: Route metadata requires parent circulation/terrain integration.
No live-controller traversal or screenshots performed in this module.
Civic district buildings retain their source baked curvature; ground support/entry traversal requires parent gameplay review.
Static transport, decorative pond water and non-operational civic interiors; no services/population simulation.

summaries.source: SP-413 p91 prose, p93 Figures 5-8/5-9; p98 Tables 5-4/5-5; Table 3-2 p26; Appendix C Table 5-18 p115
summaries.preserved: All Farm A IDs, theta/z, category/area/deck provenance and source allocation; all non-plot samples/exterior records untouched.
summaries.groundReservation: z[-7,7] kept empty; 2m cross aisles and edge routes remain on analytic ground.
summaries.netPlanting: Gross original ledger areas include authored internal lanes; visible planted footprint is smaller. Extra B/C fields and orchard parks are interpretation, not additional sourced allocation.
